name: git-tools
description: Git-adjacent terminal tools that Git-for-Windows and MSYS2 do not ship: a diff pager, the GitHub CLI, a git TUI, and a status daemon

delta.description: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, and blame output with themes and customizable colors
delta.usage: git config --global core.pager delta # Set as git pager\ndelta --side-by-side file1 file2 # Side-by-side view

gh.description: GitHub CLI for repository management, issues, pull requests, and GitHub Actions
gh.usage: gh repo create myproject --public # Create repository\ngh pr create # Create pull request\ngh issue list # List issues

tig.description: Text-mode interface for Git with powerful browsing, searching, and commit visualization
tig.usage: tig # Browse repository history\ntig status # Interactive staging\ntig blame file # Blame view

gitstatusd.description: High-performance git status daemon for responsive terminal prompts
gitstatusd.usage: gitstatusd # Run status daemon\n# Used internally by powerlevel10k and other prompt themes
